Phase 1d: Added lastActivity timestamp on PATCH + watchdog stall detection (kills agents idle >15min)

Phase 2: Concurrent agents can step on each other's files — added stash warning to prompt
Phase 2: Agent logs don't capture output (claude CLI -p mode buffers stdout)
Phase 2: Explore type directives need auto-transition to planning
